text: Good evening, and welcome to Hearts News 24. I am Isla.
Our top story: Hearts will keep playing at Tynecastle for the foreseeable future.
That is right, Isla. A deal with the council was signed this afternoon, and the club say the pitch is safe.
Fraser, supporters have waited a long time for this. What does it mean for the squad?
Stability, mostly. The manager wants no distractions before the weekend, and this removes one.
We will have reaction from the fans later in the programme.
Stay with us. This is Hearts News 24.
